stem: Greenfield Logistics needs budget alarms before monthly overspend and also wants raw billing rows in S3 for Athena queries. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: AWS Billing Conductor custom billing groups
AWS Budgets with actual and forecast notifications
AWS Cost and Usage Report delivered to Amazon S3

rationale: AWS Budgets provides actual and forecast threshold notifications for proactive overspend warning. Cost and Usage Report delivers comprehensive line-item billing data to S3 for Athena analysis. Billing Conductor models internal rates but does not replace budget alarming or raw export delivery. Cost Explorer provides analysis views rather than line-item export files. Cost allocation tags improve attribution, but tags alone do not create threshold alarms or substitute for CUR export.
